title: Skill Management
desc: Manage the extended capabilities of the current agent. Skills are stored in dedicated module folders.
repo_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to remove this repository?
delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the skill "{{name}}"?
category_desc:
• **Built-in**: System-integrated skills, cannot be deleted, part of the core architecture.
• **Managed**: Globally installed skills, shared across all agents.
• **Workspace**: Agent-specific skills, stored in the agent's workspace, has the highest priority.
